main.description: A clip created from a livestream by a viewer. This record is the authoritative source for the clip's title and description; the referenced place.stream.video carries a copy. The clip record links the video content to its source livestream for provenance and discovery.

video.description: The place.stream.video record that contains the clip's playable content.

livestream.description: AT URI of the place.stream.livestream this clip was created from.

start.description: Start time of the clip in the original livestream, in milliseconds.

end.description: End time of the clip in the original livestream, in milliseconds.

title.description: Title of the clip. Authoritative; copied to the referenced video record.

description.description: Description of the clip. Authoritative; copied to the referenced video record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this clip record was created.
